title: 27 November 1964: UK single release: I Feel Fine
content:
‘I Feel Fine’, The Beatles’ eighth Parlophone single was a standalone release not intended for their forthcoming album Beatles For Sale.

Its catalogue number was Parlophone R 5200, and the b-side was ‘She’s A Woman’.

The single entered the UK singles chart on 3 December, and from 10 December spent five weeks at number one. In all it spent 13 weeks in the chart.
